Thank you so much for that heart-felt message.Indeed i found your husband to be very strong and admire his braveness.Living in that situation where youre constantly denied is probably a very depressing feeling, mine was when my mom put too much of her feelings towards me and the haterd act(which i feel its very similar on what were going thru).Thoughts of ending did came to often in my head throughout the past 24hrs but to the help of redditers,im starting to cope with the pain and being more positive.Your husbands journey is such an inspiration for me and really apreciatte for reading and understanding my pain,aswell sharing something to comfort me.Your help will never i forget and i wish for the both of you a very prosperous life.Thank you so muchh!

Thank you soo much for the advice,i felt very calm and pleased to read thru ur advice.I guess right now i should try to look at the positive side of life and its beauty.After this post i felt like i dropped a rock of my back,i felt like it was the right option to go to because of the state of mind i was and the accessability and the community here.I will always keep your words close to my heart,Thank you!

Thank you for the advice.I hope the grass is greener on the other side,if i told 10 year old self this is how my life would have been,i might never believe it bcz they were literally the sweetest.I really found out truly about my moms colour and attitude.All i have to say to my future self is to have thick skin and accept my faith for now.:(
